symptomShortText: Pressure drop 1.4 bar detected at 6 bar hydraulic leak test station

defect.defectText: Hydraulic pressure test leak due to O-ring seal extrusion

causesIshikawa.description: EMP-7712, Shift B - assembly technician installed O-rings using guided assembly mandrel per SOP
Automated leak test bench EQ-LEAK08-001 pressure transducers and pneumatic sealing plugs fully functional
DOC-2210 Rev D - groove dimensions (width 3.2mm, depth 2.3mm) and assembly sequence compliant
NBR rubber O-ring supplier lot OR-9912 received with incorrect Shore A hardness of 54 vs drawing specification of 70 +/- 5 Shore A; soft material extruded into clearance gap under 6 bar test pressure
Durometer hardness gage GA-0222 calibrated per ISO 7619-1
Hydraulic test oil ISO VG 46 temperature 24.1C compliant

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did the assembled pump housing leak during end-of-line testing?
fiveWhyChain.answer: Hydraulic oil leaked past the main flange sealing interface at 6 bar test pressure
fiveWhyChain.evidenceCitation: Leak test station 8 data acquisition log

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did the O-ring fail to maintain pressure seal?
fiveWhyChain.answer: The O-ring cross-section suffered gap extrusion and nibbling along the outer mating flange edge
fiveWhyChain.evidenceCitation: Teardown visual analysis and microscope photos

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did the O-ring extrude into the clearance gap? (root cause)
fiveWhyChain.answer: Incoming O-ring batch OR-9912 was supplied with low-hardness 54 Shore A NBR compound instead of 70 Shore A due to supplier compounding error
fiveWhyChain.evidenceCitation: Incoming material re-test certificate and supplier 8D response

actions.actionText: Purge all remaining O-ring stock from batch OR-9912 in warehouse and assembly line kitting bins
Issue supplier corrective action request to rubber vendor and re-qualify replacement batch OR-9920
Mandate sample Shore A Durometer hardness check on every incoming elastomer lot in SAP QM inspection plan

fmeaLink.description: Hydraulic seal leakage caused by out-of-spec elastomer hardness and gap extrusion

lessonsLearned.whatWorked: 100% end-of-line pressure decay test prevented any defective pumps from reaching customer
lessonsLearned.whatDidnt: Incoming inspection accepted supplier Certificate of Analysis without verifying Shore A hardness

isIsNot.isWhereWhenItHappens: P90 housings assembled with O-ring batch OR-9912 on 2026-08-12
isIsNot.isNotWhereWhenItDoesnt: Housings assembled with O-ring batch OR-9908 with verified 70 Shore A hardness
isIsNot.notes: Failure strictly limited to supplier rubber batch OR-9912 compounding error
